convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'TSI_WPR' and two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator must be replicated; money management relies on external library functions with multiple margin modes.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
derived_values.formula: WPRPeriod + MomPeriod + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength1,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength2,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength3,XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Buy closed when main line crosses below signal line (Ind[1]<Sign[1] and BuyPosClose=true)
Sell closed when main line crosses above signal line (Ind[1]>Sign[1] and SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses, LOT=fixed lot size. When MMMode=LOT, MM value is treated as fixed lots; otherwise MM is a fraction (0.1 = 10%) of the respective margin base.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses previous bar (bar[1]) crossover condition combined with current bar (bar[0]) crossunder/crossover confirmation: BUY_Open requires Ind[1]>Sign[1] (prev bar bullish) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current bar crossing down from above - actually this triggers on the transition where main was above signal on prev bar and now at or below on current bar, signaling the crossover moment). SignalBar input (default=1) shifts which bar is used as the reference for signal detection. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean toggles allowing independent enable/disable of each trade direction and close action. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. LoadHistory ensures sufficient bar data is loaded before signal check.
python_conversion_notes: 1. The TSI_WPR custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it computes a True Strength Index applied to Williams' Percent Range, with triple smoothing using configurable methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ - these must be reimplemented with proper margin mode handling (5 modes). 3. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides GetStartBars() for warmup period calculation and all non-standard smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) - the default EMA mode simplifies this. 4. CIsNewBar class must be replicated for new-bar detection. 5. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000 points = 100 pips on 5-digit, so verify point-vs-pip semantics in Python. 6. The entry logic uses a two-bar pattern: previous bar direction check (Ind[1] vs Sign[1]) plus current bar crossover confirmation (Ind[0] vs Sign[0]), which is a specific crossover-at-the-edge detection pattern.
